candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Silvano Fashion Group reported consolidated revenue of 28,590 thousand EUR for the first six months of 2026, representing a 0.6% increase compared to 28,428 thousand EUR in the same period of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue growth was driven primarily by a 13.6% expansion in retail sales to 13,548 thousand EUR, which offset a 9.1% decline in wholesale revenue to 14,934 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: The largest market, Russia, contributed 55.1% of total sales at 15,767 thousand EUR, while Belarus accounted for 31.6% with sales reaching 9,046 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Sales in Belarus increased by 6.4%, supported by a 2.7% rise in local currency volume, whereas Russian local currency sales decreased by 7.8%.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Sales in Ukraine fell 58.3% to 15 thousand EUR, and the Baltics declined 16.7% to 484 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Gross profit improved to 15,892 thousand EUR, up 5.3% from the prior year, resulting in an expanded gross margin of 55.6% compared to 53.1%.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: However, operating profit declined by 3.5% to 5,751 thousand EUR as increased distribution and administrative expenses outpaced revenue gains, pushing the operating margin down to 20.1% from 21.0%.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Consolidated EBITDA fell slightly by 0.8% to 7,508 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Net profit attributable to equity holders of the Parent company dropped significantly by 31.5% to 3,961 thousand EUR, yielding earnings per share of 0.11 EUR against 0.16 EUR previously.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The decline was influenced by higher income tax expenses and a reduction in net finance income to 444 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Despite the lower bottom line, operating cash flow strengthened substantially, rising 96.6% to 6,842 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The company maintained a robust financial position with total assets increasing by 5.1% to 98,603 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Cash and cash equivalents grew by 87.4% to 12,443 thousand EUR, and equity attributable to parent shareholders rose by 6.1% to 81,479 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Working capital shifts included a decrease in the inventory balance by 1,535 thousand EUR to 29,702 thousand EUR, contrasting with an increase in trade and other receivables by 846 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Capital investments totaled 115 thousand EUR, directed mainly toward opening and renovating own stores.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The Group operated 135 owned stores as of June 30, with 67 in Russia and 65 in Belarus, while total employment stood at 1,594 employees.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Return on assets declined to 7.8% from 10.0%, and return on equity decreased to 9.5% from 12.5%.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Shareholders approved the 2025 results, leaving retained earnings undistributed, and appointed Treetiger OÜ as auditor.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Management emphasized a strategy to improve retail profitability in Russia amidst currency challenges.

evaluation.label: Yes
evaluation.justification: All ten key information units are fully represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by revenue, gross profit, operating profit and net profit figures; K2 by the retail/wholesale split; K3 by the Russia/Belarus/Ukraine performance and store counts; K4 by the margin progression; K5 by the cash-flow and cash-balance growth; K6 by the asset and equity growth; K7 by the management commentary on retail profitability; K8 by the inventory and receivables movements; K9 by the employee count; and K10 by the EPS decline. No material omissions exist.
